How buying works for now

  1. Pick a product and open its page.
  2. Use the enquiry link — it emails the chapter directly.
  3. We confirm batch availability, price and pickup/delivery.

This phase keeps things honest: no cart, no online payments yet, and no product claims we can't back. A proper checkout arrives with our store upgrades.

Where products come from

Made by real people we know.

Canvas totes come from the artisan community of Project Kalakaari. Potted plants are grown by the gardeners behind Project Srijan. Products come from our projects, and money stays with makers first.

Meet the projects behind the products
E Enactus ARSD

Enactus ARSD is the student-led Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. We use entrepreneurial action to create livelihoods, dignity and well-being in the communities around our campus.
